title: The Last Protocol Again
author: Mara Almeida
blurb: Xanthe Winterbourne, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
